name: Sync translations

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch translations
        run: |
          curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/docusealco/docuseal/master/config/locales/i18n.yml -o i18n.yml
          curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/docusealco/docuseal/master/app/javascript/template_builder/i18n.js -o builder_i18n.js
          curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/docusealco/docuseal/master/app/javascript/submission_form/i18n.js -o form_i18n.js

      - name: Commit and push
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          git diff --staged --quiet || (git commit -m "update translations" && git push)

# 🌍 DocuSeal I18n

Translations for the [DocuSeal](https://www.docuseal.com) open-source e-signature platform. See [Languages Support](https://www.docuseal.com/resources/languages-support) for more details.

This repository mirrors the translation files from the main [DocuSeal](https://github.com/docusealco/docuseal) project to make it easier to contribute, review, and improve translations via pull requests.
